articles.title: Cyclist, 39, killed in Stoughton crash
articles.description:
Mark Salvador, 39, of Stoughton, was killed in a crash Wednesday morning, officials said.

The post Cyclist, 39, killed in Stoughton crash appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Mark Salvador, 39, was killed in a Stoughton crash on Wednesday morning.
The incident raises concerns about cyclist safety in the Boston area.
Local officials may review traffic regulations to enhance cyclist protection.

articles.title: Wu unveiled a street safety plan after a cyclist was killed. Transit advocates say it doesn’t go far enough.
articles.description:
“This letter doubles-down on the same, never-ending community process that ensures, as we’ve seen in the last year, that nothing gets built,” one advocate says.

The post Wu unveiled a street safety plan after a cyclist was killed. Transit advocates say it doesn’t go far enough. appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Mayor Wu unveiled a new street safety plan following a cyclist's death in Boston.
Transit advocates criticize the plan for lacking urgency and effectiveness in improving safety.
Residents fear continued delays in infrastructure improvements could lead to more accidents.
